scares.description: While Father Harris and Margaret are talking in the back of the car a passerby suddenly hits the window, startling Margaret.
After Carlita crawls towards Margaret, she startles her by suddenly grabbing her face.
When the wind-blown curtain falls back down, Margaret’s habit has changed into an older nun, who turns, moves toward her, and cries out.
When the camera cuts from Carlita back to Margaret a hand suddenly grabs her over the shoulder, startling her.
A man is suddenly hit by a car, accompanied by the loud screech of tires.
When the camera cuts from Margaret back to the burned woman, she leans in with an unearthly scream as flames illuminate her face.
Not long after Margaret vomits in the backseat of the car, it’s hit by another vehicle, accompanied by loud glass breaking and impact sounds.
